items.instructions: Read the four texts. For each statement, choose the person (Person A, Person B, Person C, or Person D) who expresses that opinion.

items.title: Matching Headings - Test 01
items.instructions: Read the passage quickly. Choose a heading for each numbered paragraph (1-7) from the drop-down box.
Listen to short audio recordings. For each recording, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C). You can listen to each recording up to two times.
Listen to four people talking about a common topic. For each speaker, choose the statement that best matches their opinion from the list.
Listen to two people discussing a topic. Read the opinions below and decide whose opinion matches each statement (Man, Woman, or Both).
Listen to the extended monologues and answer the comprehension questions.
In this part, you will answer three questions about yourself. You have 30 seconds for each response.
Describe the photograph and answer the two follow-up questions. You have 45 seconds for each response.
Compare the two photographs and answer the two follow-up questions. You have 45 seconds for each response.
In this part, you will speak for two minutes on a topic. You will have one minute to prepare your response.
